capabilities: Track one Git repository per vault folder
Stage, commit, push, pull, sync and fetch from a Source Control panel
Create remote repositories on GitHub or Forgejo
Auto-commit and auto-push on a per-repository interval
Browse commit history and restore a file to an earlier version
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.11.4+); Git must be on PATH or set in settings. Tokens are kept in Obsidian SecretStorage outside the vault. No rebase, tags, branch rename or per-hunk staging; amending a pushed commit needs a terminal.
problem: Git plugins for Obsidian treat the whole vault as one repository, so folders that belong in separate repositories cannot be tracked independently.

relations.evidence: Folder Git brings VS Code-style Git source control to Obsidian.
It works with GitHub and Forgejo / Gitea (including Codeberg and self-hosted instances).

summary: Per-folder Git source control panel that manages a separate repository for each vault folder, with GitHub and Forgejo integration.
